segments.text: So far we've examined a number of extremely common techniques for the chemistry laboratory.
segments.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经了解了化学实验室中许多极其常见的技术。

segments.text: Today we are going to do something a little different.
segments.zh: 今天我们要做点不一样的事情。

segments.text: We are going to talk about how batteries work.
segments.zh: 我们要讲讲电池是如何工作的。

segments.text: A battery works by converting chemical energy into electrical energy, and this is covered
segments.zh: 电池的工作原理是把化学能转化为电能，这属于

segments.text: in a branch of chemistry we call electrochemistry, which we discussed in the lecture series.
segments.zh: 化学的一个分支，我们称之为电化学，我们在讲授系列中讨论过它。

segments.text: In the case of a type of electrochemical cell called a galvanic cell, the production of
segments.zh: 对于一种叫做原电池的电化学电池来说，

segments.text: electricity is achieved by a spontaneous oxidation-reduction reaction, or a redox reaction.
segments.zh: 电是通过自发的氧化还原反应产生的。

segments.text: These reactions work by coupling oxidation and reduction, or a transfer of electrons from
segments.zh: 这些反应的原理是把氧化和还原耦合起来，也就是电子从

segments.text: one substance to another.
segments.zh: 一种物质转移到另一种物质。

segments.text: In an oxidation there is a loss of electrons.
segments.zh: 氧化是失去电子。

segments.text: In a reduction there is a gain of electrons.
segments.zh: 还原是得到电子。

segments.text: Since the redox reaction involves a flow of electrons, it can do work to produce electricity,
segments.zh: 由于氧化还原反应涉及电子的流动，它可以做功来产生电，

segments.text: just like how flowing water in a river can do work to push a water wheel.
segments.zh: 就像河里流动的水可以做功推动水车一样。

segments.text: This is because electricity is a flow of electrons.
segments.zh: 这是因为电就是电子的流动。

segments.text: To construct a galvanic cell in the laboratory, we need to set up the oxidation and reduction
segments.zh: 要在实验室里构建原电池，我们需要把氧化反应和还原反应

segments.text: reactions separately and connect them together.
segments.zh: 分开设置，再把它们连接起来。

segments.text: These two sides are what we call half-cells.
segments.zh: 这两边就是我们所说的半电池。

segments.text: The electrons are produced by oxidation on the left side, which is called the anode,
segments.zh: 电子在左侧由氧化反应产生，左侧叫做阳极，

segments.text: where neutral metal atoms donate electrons to become ions and join the solution.
segments.zh: 在那里中性金属原子给出电子变成离子，进入溶液。

segments.text: On the right side, called the cathode, the reduction takes place as ions in the solution
segments.zh: 右侧叫做阴极，在那里发生还原反应，溶液中的离子

segments.text: gain electrons and deposit onto the electrode.
segments.zh: 得到电子并沉积到电极上。

segments.text: In a common example of a galvanic cell, we have zinc on the anode and copper on
segments.zh: 在原电池的一个常见例子中，阳极是锌，阴极是

segments.text: the cathode.
segments.zh: 铜。

segments.text: The zinc metal loses two electrons to become zinc 2 plus and goes into solution.
segments.zh: 锌金属失去两个电子变成 Zn²⁺，进入溶液。

segments.text: The solution is usually one of zinc ions such as zinc sulfate.
segments.zh: 溶液通常是锌离子溶液，比如硫酸锌。

segments.text: On the cathode, we have copper metal and a solution of copper ions such as copper sulfate.
segments.zh: 在阴极，我们有铜金属和铜离子溶液，比如硫酸铜。

segments.text: The copper ions gain two electrons to become neutral copper and deposit on the copper electrode.
segments.zh: 铜离子得到两个电子变成中性的铜，沉积在铜电极上。

segments.text: We must connect these two cells by what we call a salt bridge.
segments.zh: 我们必须用所谓的盐桥把这两个半电池连接起来。

segments.text: A salt bridge is a salt solution that is used to transfer ions and reduce the accumulation
segments.zh: 盐桥是一种盐溶液，用来传递离子，减少两侧

segments.text: of charge on either side.
segments.zh: 电荷的积累。

segments.text: When the half cells are prepared and ready to go, they will be producing electricity.
segments.zh: 当半电池准备就绪后，它们就会产生电。

segments.text: All you have to do is connect the metal electrodes to a light bulb or simply a volt
segments.zh: 你只需要把金属电极连接到一个灯泡上，或者干脆接一个电压

segments.text: meter to measure the voltage that's going through.
segments.zh: 表，测量通过的电压。

segments.text: We are going to build a cell like this today.
segments.zh: 今天我们就要搭建一个这样的电池。

segments.text: To build a galvanic cell, we're going to start with the two half cells.
segments.zh: 要搭建原电池，我们先从两个半电池开始。

segments.text: We're just going to use two beakers for that, and in the beakers we'll add the two solutions,
segments.zh: 我们就用两个烧杯来做，在烧杯里加入两种溶液，

segments.text: zinc sulfate and copper sulfate.
segments.zh: 硫酸锌和硫酸铜。

segments.text: We're then going to place the metal electrodes into each solution like this.
segments.zh: 然后我们像这样把金属电极分别放进每种溶液中。

segments.text: The zinc metal goes into the zinc sulfate solution and the copper metal into the copper
segments.zh: 锌金属放进硫酸锌溶液，铜金属放进硫酸

segments.text: sulfate solution.
segments.zh: 铜溶液。

segments.text: We'll then connect the two solutions with a salt bridge.
segments.zh: 然后我们用盐桥把两种溶液连接起来。

segments.text: A salt bridge can be a YouTube that's filled with a salt solution, but it can
segments.zh: 盐桥可以是一根装满盐溶液的 U 形管，但它也可以

segments.text: also be a paper towel that has been dipped in the salt solution.
segments.zh: 是一张在盐溶液中浸过的纸巾。

segments.text: Today we're going to use potassium iodide for our salt bridge.
segments.zh: 今天我们要用碘化钾来做盐桥。

segments.text: Let's cut up some filter paper and dip it into our solution.
segments.zh: 我们剪一些滤纸，浸入我们的溶液中。

segments.text: This is what we will use to connect the two beakers.
segments.zh: 我们就用这个来连接两个烧杯。

segments.text: Now that we've created our two cells and connected them by a salt bridge, let's add
segments.zh: 现在我们已经做好了两个半电池，并用盐桥把它们连接起来，接下来加上

segments.text: a volt meter so that we can measure the voltage.
segments.zh: 一个电压表，这样我们就可以测量电压了。

segments.text: And look at that, we are already producing electricity.
segments.zh: 看，我们已经在发电了。

segments.text: The reactions in the two half cells are producing a flow of electrons that are being
segments.zh: 两个半电池中的反应正在产生电子流，并被

segments.text: picked up by our volt meter.
segments.zh: 电压表检测到。

segments.text: As you can see here, we have a reading of approximately one volt.
segments.zh: 如你所见，这里的读数大约是 1 伏。

segments.text: In the lecture series, we talked about how to calculate the theoretical voltage of a galvanic
segments.zh: 在讲授系列中，我们讲过如何计算原电池的

segments.text: cell.
segments.zh: 理论电压。

segments.text: It is the case that each of these half cell reactions has a standard potential that's
segments.zh: 事实上，每个半电池反应都有一个已知的、

segments.text: already known and tabulated.
segments.zh: 已经列成表的标准电势。

segments.text: The potential of the cell as a whole is derived by the standard reduction potential at the
segments.zh: 整个电池的电势等于阴极的标准还原电势

segments.text: cathode minus the standard reduction potential at the anode, and that is how you calculate
segments.zh: 减去阳极的标准还原电势，这就是计算

segments.text: the total voltage.
segments.zh: 总电压的方法。

segments.text: Once calculated, we can compare our theoretical voltage to the experimental voltage.
segments.zh: 计算出来后，我们就可以把理论电压与实验电压进行比较。

segments.text: For our experiment, as we can see, our experimental voltage is pretty close to the theoretical
segments.zh: 对于我们的实验，如你所见，实验电压与理论

segments.text: voltage.
segments.zh: 电压相当接近。

segments.text: Another experiment we can do is to figure out how the concentrations of the solutions
segments.zh: 我们还可以做另一个实验，弄清楚半电池中溶液的浓度

segments.text: in the half cells affect the voltage.
segments.zh: 如何影响电压。

segments.text: This can be calculated using the Nernst equation.
segments.zh: 这可以用能斯特方程来计算。

segments.text: As you can see here, it is really about the ratio between the two.
segments.zh: 如你所见，关键在于两者之间的比值。

segments.text: So if we measure this when both solutions are at half the original concentration, the
segments.zh: 所以如果我们在两种溶液都是原浓度一半时测量，

segments.text: voltage will stay the same.
segments.zh: 电压会保持不变。

segments.text: However, if we change only one concentration and not the other, the voltage will change.
segments.zh: 然而，如果我们只改变其中一种的浓度而不改变另一种，电压就会改变。

segments.text: Once we are done with this particular galvanic cell, we can replace one solution and electrode
segments.zh: 用完这个原电池后，我们可以把其中一种溶液和电极

segments.text: with another solution and electrode, such as nickel in this case.
segments.zh: 换成另一种溶液和电极，比如这里换成镍。

segments.text: We can then measure the voltage between that half cell and that of copper or zinc.
segments.zh: 然后我们可以测量这个半电池与铜或锌半电池之间的电压。

segments.text: So the more half cells you have, the more pairings you can make.
segments.zh: 所以你拥有的半电池越多，能组成的配对就越多。

segments.text: With three half cells you can make three different galvanic cells.
segments.zh: 有三个半电池，你可以组成三种不同的原电池。

segments.text: If you have four half cells, you can make six different cells, and so forth.
segments.zh: 如果有四个半电池，你可以组成六种不同的电池，依此类推。

segments.text: But you still measure the voltage the same way every time.
segments.zh: 但每次测量电压的方法都是一样的。

segments.text: So that's how chemical reactions can produce electricity, and that's also how the battery
segments.zh: 这就是化学反应产生电的原理，也是你手机或汽车里的电池

segments.text: in your cell phone or your car works.
segments.zh: 工作的原理。

segments.text: Of course the batteries in your devices will have more sophisticated reactions happening
segments.zh: 当然，你设备中的电池在阳极和阴极发生的反应

segments.text: at the anode and cathode, but they still utilize the same concept of a redox reaction
segments.zh: 更复杂，但它们仍然利用同样的概念：半电池中的

segments.text: in half cells, connected by a salt bridge and some way to harvest the electricity.
segments.zh: 氧化还原反应，通过盐桥连接，再加上某种收集电能的方式。
